```{r}
calculate_f1 <- function(actual, predicted) {
  TP <- sum(actual == 1 & predicted == 1)
  FP <- sum(actual == 0 & predicted == 1)
  FN <- sum(actual == 1 & predicted == 0)

  precision <- if ((TP + FP) == 0) 0 else TP / (TP + FP)
  recall <- if ((TP + FN) == 0) 0 else TP / (TP + FN)

  if ((precision + recall) == 0) return(0)

  2 * precision * recall / (precision + recall)
}

```



```{r}
# Install once if needed
if (!requireNamespace("xgboost", quietly = TRUE)) {
  install.packages("xgboost")
}

library(xgboost)

set.seed(4610)

features <- paste0("x", 1:10)

stopifnot(all(features %in% names(train_data)))
stopifnot(all(features %in% names(test_data)))
stopifnot("Y" %in% names(train_data))
stopifnot("ID" %in% names(test_data))

y <- as.integer(as.character(train_data$Y))
stopifnot(!anyNA(y), all(y %in% c(0L, 1L)))

X_train <- train_data[, features, drop = FALSE]
X_test <- test_data[, features, drop = FALSE]

for (nm in features) {
  if (is.factor(X_train[[nm]]) ||
      is.character(X_train[[nm]]) ||
      is.factor(X_test[[nm]]) ||
      is.character(X_test[[nm]])) {

    levels_all <- unique(c(
      as.character(X_train[[nm]]),
      as.character(X_test[[nm]])
    ))

    X_train[[nm]] <- factor(
      X_train[[nm]], levels = levels_all
    )

    X_test[[nm]] <- factor(
      X_test[[nm]], levels = levels_all
    )
  }
}

str(X_train)
table(y)
```


```{r}
set.seed(4610)

class_indices <- lapply(
  split(seq_along(y), y),
  function(ids) sample(ids, length(ids))
)

train_idx <- unlist(lapply(class_indices, function(ids) {
  ids[seq_len(floor(length(ids) * 0.70))]
}))

tune_idx <- unlist(lapply(class_indices, function(ids) {
  n <- length(ids)
  ids[(floor(n * 0.70) + 1):floor(n * 0.85)]
}))

valid_idx <- setdiff(
  seq_along(y), c(train_idx, tune_idx)
)

# XGBoost data objects
dtrain <- xgb.DMatrix(
  data = X_train[train_idx, , drop = FALSE],
  label = y[train_idx]
)

dtune <- xgb.DMatrix(
  data = X_train[tune_idx, , drop = FALSE],
  label = y[tune_idx]
)

dvalid <- xgb.DMatrix(
  data = X_train[valid_idx, , drop = FALSE],
  label = y[valid_idx]
)

cat("Training:", length(train_idx), "\n")
cat("Tuning:", length(tune_idx), "\n")
cat("Validation:", length(valid_idx), "\n")

```


```{r}
# Initial hyperparameter search
grid <- expand.grid(
  max_depth = c(3, 5),
  eta = c(0.03, 0.07)
)

# Threshold candidates
thresholds <- seq(0.10, 0.80, by = 0.01)

results <- data.frame()
models <- list()
all_threshold_scores <- list()

for (i in seq_len(nrow(grid))) {

  params <- list(
    objective = "binary:logistic",
    eval_metric = "aucpr",
    tree_method = "hist",
    max_depth = grid$max_depth[i],
    eta = grid$eta[i],
    min_child_weight = 5,
    subsample = 0.85,
    colsample_bytree = 0.9,
    nthread = 2,
    seed = 4610
  )

  model <- xgb.train(
    params = params,
    data = dtrain,
    nrounds = 1200,
    evals = list(tuning = dtune),
    early_stopping_rounds = 60,
    verbose = 0
  )

  # Best iteration is stored with 0-based indexing
  best_round <- as.integer(
    xgb.attr(model, "best_iteration")
  ) + 1L

  # Predict default probabilities
  prob <- predict(
    model,
    dtune,
    iterationrange = c(1L, best_round)
  )

  # Find the F1-maximizing threshold
  scores <- sapply(thresholds, function(t) {
    predicted <- as.integer(prob >= t)
    calculate_f1(y[tune_idx], predicted)
  })

  best_t <- thresholds[which.max(scores)]
  best_f1 <- max(scores)

  results <- rbind(results, data.frame(
    model_id = i,
    max_depth = grid$max_depth[i],
    eta = grid$eta[i],
    best_round = best_round,
    threshold = best_t,
    tuning_f1 = best_f1
  ))

  models[[i]] <- model
  all_threshold_scores[[i]] <- scores

  cat(
    "Model", i,
    "| F1:", round(best_f1, 4),
    "| Threshold:", best_t,
    "| Rounds:", best_round, "\n"
  )
}


results <- results[order(-results$tuning_f1), ]
print(results)


```


```{r}
best_id <- results$model_id[1]
best_threshold <- results$threshold[1]
best_round <- results$best_round[1]

plot(
  thresholds,
  all_threshold_scores[[best_id]],
  type = "l",
  lwd = 2,
  xlab = "Classification Threshold",
  ylab = "F1 Score",
  main = "Gradient Boosting: F1 vs Threshold"
)

abline(v = best_threshold, lty = 2)

cat("Selected threshold:", best_threshold, "\n")

```

```{r}
best_model <- models[[best_id]]

valid_prob <- predict(
  best_model,
  dvalid,
  iterationrange = c(1L, best_round)
)

valid_pred <- as.integer(
  valid_prob >= best_threshold
)

validation_f1 <- calculate_f1(
  y[valid_idx],
  valid_pred
)

cat("Final Validation F1:", validation_f1, "\n")

# Confusion matrix
print(table(
  Actual = y[valid_idx],
  Predicted = valid_pred
))

# Additional metrics
TP <- sum(y[valid_idx] == 1 & valid_pred == 1)
FP <- sum(y[valid_idx] == 0 & valid_pred == 1)
FN <- sum(y[valid_idx] == 1 & valid_pred == 0)

precision <- if (TP + FP == 0) 0 else TP / (TP + FP)
recall <- if (TP + FN == 0) 0 else TP / (TP + FN)

cat("Precision:", precision, "\n")
cat("Recall:", recall, "\n")
cat("F1:", validation_f1, "\n")

```

```{r}
  model = best_model
)

print(importance)

xgb.plot.importance(
  importance_matrix = importance
)
```


```{r}
# Full training data
dfull <- xgb.DMatrix(
  data = X_train,
  label = y
)

dtest <- xgb.DMatrix(
  data = X_test
)

# Reuse selected hyperparameters
final_params <- list(
  objective = "binary:logistic",
  eval_metric = "aucpr",
  tree_method = "hist",
  max_depth = results$max_depth[1],
  eta = results$eta[1],
  min_child_weight = 5,
  subsample = 0.85,
  colsample_bytree = 0.9,
  nthread = 2,
  seed = 4610
)

final_model <- xgb.train(
  params = final_params,
  data = dfull,
  nrounds = best_round,
  verbose = 0
)

# Predict test probabilities
test_prob <- predict(final_model, dtest)

# Convert to labels using selected threshold
test_pred <- as.integer(
  test_prob >= best_threshold
)

# Submission data frame
submission <- data.frame(
  ID = test_data$ID,
  Y = test_pred
)

# Validate submission
stopifnot(nrow(submission) == nrow(test_data))
stopifnot(identical(names(submission), c("ID", "Y")))
stopifnot(all(submission$Y %in% c(0L, 1L)))
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(submission$ID))

# Save CSV
write.csv(
  submission,
  "submission.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

head(submission)
table(submission$Y)

```
